item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 with a 2M-token context window
item.dc:creator: Jane Reporter
item.content:encoded:
OpenAI on Wednesday released GPT-6, a new large language model that it says can read up to two million tokens at once.

The model is available to paying users today & via the API.
